# Bruto

> A free, open-source task board for projects built with AI. Notes live inside the project folder, in `.bruto/workspace.json`, so you and any AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) read and answer the same tasks. No account, no server, works offline.

- You write tasks as notes: description, files, links, screenshots and a status.
- One key (`Q`, `W` or `E`) copies exactly the context the AI needs, as Markdown with instructions for the model.
- An AI that can edit files answers inside the note, lists the files it changed and marks it for review; "changes requested" sends it back with what is still wrong.
- Coding agents can work the board through the MCP server (`npx -y bruto-mcp`): list and read notes, mark the one they are on and answer it, without editing the JSON by hand.
- A note is a task, a bug or a standing rule. Rules ("run the tests before finishing") go into every copy, and the AI applies them on every task until they are closed.
- A note can block, wait on or relate to a note in another project (front end, API, database); both boards show the link.
- The structure view and its lenses draw the project (web apps, APIs, databases) with the notes on top. The database lens searches hundreds of tables by name or column, including the ones the code uses but no script creates.
- Runs in Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera on a computer. MIT license.

## Links

- [Bruto](https://jimy-k4.github.io/bruto/): the app
- [Example project](https://jimy-k4.github.io/bruto/?demo): opens a sample board right away, in the browser
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jimy-k4/bruto/main/README.md): features, working with an AI, the workspace file format and shortcuts
- [bruto-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bruto-mcp): the MCP server for coding agents
- [Source code](https://github.com/jimy-k4/bruto)
